finding_for_the_represented_execution_fa.order_read_from: the artifact's ops_in_index_order, cross-checked against the sealed table set
finding_for_the_represented_execution_fa.sealed_schema_is_set_valued: Setting.json sorts the operation tables and collapses repetitions, so it determines neither the index order the enablements refer to nor the operation count

causal_footprint.independence: an edit to an instance away from the active datum does not change the step, and an edit at it does: the represented execution family's test_an_edit_away_from_the_active_datum_leaves_the_step_unchanged and its mutation tests.  Computed on those populations; no theorem states it
causal_footprint.not_delivered: the observed process has one locus of activity, so no square is stated of its observations; the producer family has since built two loci as a product carrier and proved the square there (its Product.left_right_comm, Product.coupling_breaks_the_square), and the lifting to a two-locus run and its observations is what remains
causal_footprint.reads: a firing reads the enablement self-instance and the operation edge at the active datum (Control.fire, Control.enabled)
causal_footprint.writes: active, tape, clock, fuel; the program is kept (Control.fire_ok)

classification: deterministic computation: the represented process observed at step scales, and the abstract inverse system mirrored

connected_experiment.bound: L <= 3 * count <= L + 2 for a tape of length L
connected_experiment.limit: the frequency count / L lies within 2 / (3 L) of 1 / 3 at every scale; the limiting value 1 / 3 is the rational the bound isolates, and precision e needs L >= 2 / (3 e)
connected_experiment.observed_from: one state, at four scales: obs n s, the Lean Observe.obs
connected_experiment.readout: the number of entries equal to datum 0 in the tape

limit.cofinal_rescaling: Limits.thread_even, Limits.even_thread: the even scales have the same threads, through the sequences; Limits.restrictEven and Limits.restrictEven_eq: the map that carries them is the restriction of a thread to the even scales, which is what limits.even_family computes
limit.construction: Limits.ofSeq; the inverse pair Limits.ofSeq_toSeq and Limits.toSeq_ofSeq: the thread space is the sequence space, a bijection and not a mediating-map statement; no choice or compactness is used
limit.stages: words of length n over the carrier (Limits.Stage)
limit.thread_space: compatible families at every scale (Limits.Compatible, Limits.Thread)
limit.topology: declared, not proved: the product of the discrete topologies on the finite stages; totally disconnected; not an interval, not a circle; none is claimed, and an interval would need an order or metric compatible with the stages and an identification of threads this family does not make

lost_fuel.repair: observe the fuel beside the tape; with the program, the active datum and the fuel the next observation is determined (Observe.next_active_det)

not_delivered: an interval, circle or integration theory: the limit is a totally disconnected thread space and a rational frequency with a bound
lifting the successor relation of a fork to threads: the deterministic runner stops at a fork
a general theorem that every realized tape is eventually periodic: the determinism of the next datum is proved, the eventual periodicity is computed over the declared class
a two-locus run and its observation at step scales: the producer family built the second locus as a product carrier and proved the independence square on operations, but no run of it is observed here

observation_system.bonding: forget the entries beyond the coarser length
observation_system.fuel_independence: Observe.obs_fuel_indep, obs_fuel_eq: two states agreeing on graph, operation count, active datum and tape, each with at least n fuel, have the same observation at scale n; the fuel is consulted only to refuse
observation_system.scale: the number of steps of the deterministic runner watched
observation_system.why: a step only appends (Control.fire_ok through Observe.next_tape)

shift.meaning: two words with one prefix of length 2 shift to different words: the entry beyond the observed boundary would have to be supplied (Limits.shift_not_local)

tape_is_the_sequence.bound_on_the_run: Observe.forever_length, forever_zeros, forever_run_bound: the readout of the observation itself obeys L <= 3 * count <= L + 2
tape_is_the_sequence.theorem: Observe.forever_iter, forever_obs: after n steps of the cycle-everywhere program from datum 0, with fuel to spare, the active datum is n % 3 and the tape is the first n + 1 entries of i -> i % 3
tape_is_the_sequence.was: computed at every recorded scale and labelled the missing connection; proved now

verdicts.class: every program on the recorded setting with at most one operation enabled per datum, from every datum
verdicts.injective: the observation at the scale of a tape's length is the tape itself: injective on tapes
verdicts.why_not_surjective: a realized tape is functional (equal entries have equal successors, Observe.next_active_det), so no thread with the prefix [0, 1, 0, 2] is realized; the full thread space contains it

which_threads.all_mathematical_sequences: the thread space is all of them (the construction is total)
which_threads.computably_presented: between the two; not characterised here
which_threads.process_generated: functional tapes — equal entries have equal successors, proved along the whole run for every setting, start and scale (Observe.obs_functional, from the chain invariant Observe.iter_chain) — hence eventually periodic on a finite carrier, which is the standard consequence and is not formalized; a strict subset
